# DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-ja1 (GGUF) — Experimental

> **Experimental, not used in IXV.** This is a variant of ELVEZ's
> [standard V4.1 Flash 1017 Q2](https://huggingface.co/elvezjp/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-gguf) whose only
> difference is the calibration text of the imatrix: half of it is Japanese. We made it to see whether Japanese
> calibration improves Japanese output. It did not clearly improve, so IXV keeps the standard file. We publish it so
> that the result can be checked and the file reused, not as a recommended model.

`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-ja1.gguf` is a 2-bit-expert quantization of
[deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017), made by ELVEZ
from the official weights. `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-ja1-imatrix.dat` is the imatrix it was made with.

This card records what we measured and what we have not. Everything here is as of 2026-11-11.

> **Runtime.** We have run this file only on IXV's engine (`ixv-server`), with Metal on an M3 Ultra. The GGUF
> stores the Engram tables in a layout of its own, so it is not a general-purpose GGUF. The llama.cpp, Ollama and
> other snippets in the "Use this model" menu are generated by Hugging Face for every GGUF; we have not tested any of
> them, and we do not expect them to work. The Vision and DSpark files of the
> [standard repository](https://huggingface.co/elvezjp/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-gguf) work with this file
> too (we used DSpark in the evaluation below; we did not test Vision with this file).

日本語の概要は[末尾](#日本語の概要)にあります。

## Files

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---|
| `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-ja1.gguf` | 365,713,686,528 bytes | `9a8d6e703ee3f5106dbf1271ffebf8f7fba4b0a8a1f5c17c4c6dd8e2580c52ea` |
| `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-ja1-imatrix.dat` | 770,708,028 bytes | `6b9b7749ea8d4261225ac55e91e6a3eda24a8c9122d6321f3841e546c288c03b` |

The files were renamed after conversion so that the names show they are ELVEZ's. The GGUF's metadata still records
the imatrix under its working name, `quantize.imatrix.file = DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-imatrix-8192-ja1.dat`; it is the
`.dat` above. The file contents were not changed.

## What differs from the standard Q2

| | Standard Q2 | This file (ja1) |
|---|---|---|
| Base weights, recipe, tensor types, size | official 1017, IQ2_XXS gate/up, Q2_K down, Q8_0 attention/shared/head | same |
| imatrix tokens | 8,192 | 8,192 |
| imatrix calibration text | a subset of the upstream calibration set (code, tool calls, reasoning, multilingual prose, translation) | about half the same subset (23 conversations, 4,059 tokens) and half Japanese (22 conversations, 4,133 tokens) |
| Routed experts observed by the imatrix | 14,931 / 15,360 (97.21%) | **15,112 / 15,360 (98.39%)** |

- The Japanese conversations are built from
  [nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan)
  (revision `c73cc865652320aa2a4ee1c48fcd8ccc8a3d6b94`, CC BY 4.0): rows chosen with a fixed seed, nine persona
  fields in turn (finance, financial behavior, money worries, occupation, sports, arts, travel, cooking, overall), each
  with a different request (household advice, summary, interview questions, an in-house profile, a weekly plan table,
  an introduction email, a travel itinerary, a menu, a translation into English), thinking on for 9 and off for 13.
- The two kinds of conversation alternate, so that the first 8,192 tokens are half Japanese.
- The imatrix was collected on a first (non-imatrix) conversion of the same weights, as for the standard file.

## What is in the file

Same layout as the standard Q2: 1,046 tensors; routed experts IQ2_XXS (gate, up) and Q2_K (down), weighted by the
imatrix; attention projections, shared experts and output head Q8_0; norms, router and other small tensors F16 / F32;
the Engram tables are the official FP8 values and scales, unchanged, packed at the end of the file. The main weights
that stay in memory are about 151.8 GiB.

| | |

| Calibration data | [nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan), revision `c73cc865652320aa2a4ee1c48fcd8ccc8a3d6b94`, CC BY 4.0 (only the imatrix statistics are in these files, not the text) |

## How it was made

```
deepseek41_quantize.py --hf DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 --source-revision 1bae0e10… --quant q2 --out <bootstrap>.gguf
<engine> -m <bootstrap>.gguf --imatrix-dataset <ja1 prompts> --imatrix-out DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-ja1-imatrix.dat --imatrix-max-tokens 8192
deepseek41_quantize.py --hf DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 --source-revision 1bae0e10… --quant q2 --imatrix DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-ja1-imatrix.dat --out DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-ja1.gguf
```

- The final file was made **from the official safetensors**, not by requantizing the first file. Conversion took
  66.5 minutes on the M3 Ultra (24 threads).
- Checked against the official weights with `deepseek41_validate_gguf.py --quant q2 --imatrix <ja1> --payload`: all
  1,046 tensor layouts and payloads match the recipe.
- With the `.dat` above and the official weights, the same command makes the same tensors. The metadata records
  the name of the `.dat` you pass, so pass it as `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-imatrix-8192-ja1.dat` to get a
  byte-identical file.
- As a check of the procedure, collecting the standard calibration text again gave an imatrix byte-identical to the
  one the standard file was made with (apart from the recorded prompt-file path).

## Evaluation

One machine (Mac Studio M3 Ultra 512 GB), 2026-11-10, IXV engine 1.17.4 with the production settings
(`--ctx 131072 --batched-session 1 --warm-weights`, DSpark on, no images). The standard Q2 and this file were
measured in turn with the same script. Temperature 0, one run each.

| Test | Standard Q2 | This file (ja1) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Decode speed, short / ~6.3k / ~38.8k-token prompt (tok/s) | 46.0 / 41.7 / 36.8 | 46.1 / 40.4 / 37.2 |
| Japanese knowledge QA, 48 questions (thinking off) | 46/48 | 45/48 (one more answer is correct in substance) |
| Japanese long-form writing, 6 prompts, max 4,096 tokens, judged by Claude, /20 | 13.0 | 12.3 |
| HumanEval, 164 problems (thinking on, max 16,384 tokens, re-indented) | 152/164 | 154/164 |
| Number test, 20 questions (readings in 万・億 and others; tools on; read by hand) | 18/20 | 20/20 |

- **No clear improvement in Japanese.** QA and long-form are within one question or one point. In the long-form
  answers the Japanese was natural in both; the differences were in following details of the instructions.
- HumanEval (+2) and the number test (+2) lean better, but the sets are small and each was run once, so we cannot
  tell them from chance.
- Both files think until the 4,096-token limit and give no text on the same 2 of the 6 long-form prompts.
- The Japanese QA and long-form prompts and the number test are ELVEZ's internal evaluation sets and are not published.

## Limitations

- One machine, one evaluation session, one run each at temperature 0. Small test sets.
- One calibration mix (half Japanese, 8,192 tokens). We did not try other ratios or more tokens.
- Vision was not tested with this file.
- This is not a release by DeepSeek, antirez or NVIDIA. Please report problems with these files to us, not to them.

## 日本語の概要

- **試しに作った版で、IXV では使っていません。** エルブズの[標準の V4.1 Flash 1017 Q2](https://huggingface.co/elvezjp/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-ELVEZ-Q2-gguf) と、imatrix の校正の文だけが違います。校正の文の半分を日本語にすると、日本語の出力が良くなるかを確かめるために作りました。はっきりとは良くならなかったので、IXV は標準の版を使い続けます。結果を確かめたり、ファイルを使い回したりできるように公開しています。おすすめのモデルではありません。
- 日本語の文は、NVIDIA の [Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan)（CC BY 4.0）から作りました。imatrix が観測した専門家は 97.21% から 98.39% に増えました。
- ファイル名は、エルブズのものと分かるように、作ったあとで付け直しました。
- 公式の重みから作り直したもので、作り方の手順どおりであることを 1,046 テンソルすべてで確かめました。同じ `.dat` と公式の重みがあれば、同じ中身を作れます（GGUF には渡した `.dat` の名前が記録されるので、バイト単位で同じにするには、作ったときの名前 `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-imatrix-8192-ja1.dat` で渡します）。
- Mac Studio（M3 Ultra、512 GB）の IXV で、標準の版と同じ条件で比べました。速さは同じ、日本語知識 QA 45/48（標準 46/48）、日本語の長文 12.3（標準 13.0）、HumanEval 154/164（標準 152/164）、数字の試験 20/20（標準 18/20）でした。どれも温度 0 で1回ずつで、差は偶然の範囲と見ています。
- 動作を確かめたのは IXV のエンジン（Metal、M3 Ultra）だけです。llama.cpp などの一般の GGUF の実行環境では動かない見込みです。
- ライセンスは元のモデルに合わせて MIT です。
